notes: LUNGING. Intro: the mane fluffs up and shakes left, right, left, then settles; only the head moves. The deep green shades the gold mane (a spiky terminator), the lit florets are white. Sport: pink dandelion. Taraxacum pseudoroseum, the pink dandelion of Central Asia: rose florets with pale tips (indexes 1-2 only).
